name: proto-blocks/oit-mini-cards-grid
title: OIT Mini Cards Grid
description: Compact grid of clickable industry / category pill-cards. Each card is icon + bold title + chevron, on a soft drop shadow. One card can be flagged as the red highlight variant.

highlightedIndex.label: Highlighted Card Index
highlightedIndex.help: 1-based index of the card to render with the red highlight variant. 0 = no card highlighted (and every card adopts the red look on hover).

showBottomText.label: Show bottom heading + body
showBottomText.help: Adds a red heading and supporting paragraph below the card grid (e.g. "Don't see your industry?").
